---
title: "wrapped fixture: Word width plus gap"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: docx
wrapped:
  width: 4in
---

With no reference doc the text is 9360 twips wide. The document default is
4in (5760 twips), and 40% is 3744 twips.

![A figure 5 in wide with a 2 in gap.](plot.png){#fig-abs .wrap-right width="5in" wrap-gap="2in"}

The figure takes the document default, with a warning. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
